faces.transcription: Open Door 46. Then open Door F and place that rule in the rulebook. Then draw the Pause card in the Legacy deck and read the back of it.
faces.flavor: None of the trials were disrupted, and all three cities are exposed to the pathogen. The MEDUSA symptoms are still mild, so fortunately the effect on the populace remains minimal.
